subjects.name: Kaiser Wilhelm Institute for Anthropology, Human Heredity and Eugenics

summary: German physician and SS officer Josef Mengele trained in Nazi race science, then at Auschwitz (1943-1945) selected prisoners for the gas chambers and killed twins and others in experiments supplying German institutes, before escaping to South America.

evidence.note: birth in Günzburg, southern Germany, March 1911
Verschuer introduced at the Kaiser Wilhelm Institute; twin research focus
1935 PhD thesis on jaw morphology of racial groups starts his race-science career
issues racial ancestry certificates for Nazi courts under Nuremberg laws
serves with SS Wiking in Ukraine from 1941; division massacres Jews
Zolochiv massacre by the division, war-crimes segment
Nyiszli's memoir used at length; he becomes Mengele's forced pathologist
experiments on twins, children and pregnant women; infant starvation account
twin research done to supply Verschuer and other institutes with specimens
flight to South America, life in hiding, son Rolf's visit
drowning in Brazil; then fates of Verschuer, Lenz, Hallervorden

notes: Part 1 spends roughly 15-20 minutes on 18th-19th century race science (Boulainvilliers 1727, Linnaeus, Blumenbach, Morton); treated as background, not covered years. main_span 1935-1945 covers his race-science career through Auschwitz; flight and 1979 death are short. Flight to Brazil/Paraguay too brief for setting. Kaiser Wilhelm Institute org_type ngo is approximate (research institute).
